s02052.summary: Naomi nervously waits alone at a candlelit table among the tomato plants.
Teodor arrives eleven minutes late with grocery-store carnations and wins her smile.
They talk about the missed last date, laugh together, and hold hands as a waiter takes their order.
Naomi sees a woman in a red coat in the doorway and Teodor names her Marisol.
The waiter quietly sets down the cake and nobody touches it.

s01493.summary: Nellie tells the neighbors the lease expired and the developers close the lot Friday.
They need two hundred signatures by Friday and Bridget threatens to expel Marcus if he skips canvassing.
Bridget explains she waters dead Hendricks's tomatoes every day and cannot face their loss.
Marcus cancels his meeting and takes the south side as Felix lights his pipe.

s02143.summary: Hortense holds downward dog with a goat on her back while her son Clement fusses by phone.
Clement says he's coming over and Hortense calmly tells him to bring a carrot.

s01944.summary: Vinnie and Lucky wait with a duffel and police radio for Dee.
Dee bursts in saying she was shot at while police broadcast a gray sedan alert.
Vinnie dumps the radio and they pile into the sedan and drive onto the car-wash belt.
Trapped in the wash with sirens approaching, Dee and Lucky trade deadpan quips.

s00357.summary: Coach Odette enters an empty locker room and finds a phone on the bench.
A voicemail from her past self urges Odette not to quit as she vents about the firing.
Odette opens her locker and recalls the champions and the barefoot Olympic-trials wrestler.
Odette admits she's tired, hears why she should show up, and writes 6 AM on the whiteboard.

s00695.summary: The partners trade bland pleasantries in the break room while the intern serves croissants.
Marguerite praises Phil's numbers, then Sloane announces a culture refresh transitioning roles.
Marguerite coolly tells Phil his role is being eliminated.
The intern reveals his name is Dewey and that he built their billing system.
Dewey lays down his lanyard and leaves, telling them to enjoy the croissants.

s00589.summary: A hat-hidden woman appears in Arlo's pawnshop office, claiming she has come to collect.
Gwendolyn unveils herself as Charlie Marsh's daughter and accuses Arlo of betraying him in sixty-eight.
Trevor grabs the satchel and leaves Arlo behind; Gwendolyn lets him pass.
Gwendolyn shows a revolver, then they drink bourbon to Charlie and she sets the gun down.

s00939.summary: Willow and her grandmother Esme sort old photographs in the attic.
Esme takes out Willow's mother's tin whistle and blows a single note.
Esme plays a crooked tune, Willow hums, then weeps for her mother in her grandmother's lap.

s00712.summary: Officer Tamar asks a silent unknown man his name in the interview room.
Dispatch IDs him as Desmond Pryce and flags his storage unit for a smell.
Desmond sets down his cup and evades Tamar's question about the storage unit.

s02402.summary: Roche approaches Eleanor in the dining car and sits uninvited after twenty-two years.
They trade barbed greetings while a porter offers coffee.
Roche says he kept her letters; Eleanor says she burned his.

s00388.summary: VP Phillipa bounces on a trampoline preaching psychological safety to her flattering staff.
A button pops off her blazer and lands in the coffee as everyone freezes.
Phillipa steps off and all three scatter, leaving the trampoline bouncing.

s00339.summary: Pearl heckles Uncle Roy's wobbly skating at the family reunion rink.
Tamika coaxes Junior's hood back and fixes Liliana's skates while Pearl rejects cold casserole.
Pearl silently pats Roy's knee and Junior finally lets his hood fall.

s01229.summary: Inspector Malhotra questions pilot Drummond and clerk Birgitta about a released container.
Drummond defends his record while Malhotra notes a pencil mark on the tide table.
Malhotra reveals a pilot cutter went to inspect a buoy missing since March.
Birgitta blames herself, then Drummond takes her hand and admits it was him.
Malhotra pours tea for all three and lets them drink before the waiting car.
Drummond's hands shake and Birgitta rests her head on him as a ship horn sounds.

s00881.summary: Schoolteacher Cora pays ferryman Amos for the crossing.
Sheriff Drummond arrives with a battered handcuffed prisoner and Cora challenges him.
Amos says the raft holds four; Cora takes charge and the sheriff hangs up his gun belt.

s02097.summary: Late-night host Juno goes on air as Rosalie watches from the booth.
Caller David says he wants to address Rosalie; the booth panics.
David apologizes on air and proposes; Rosalie answers through tears and laughter.

s00722.summary: Armed Deacon sits by a stranded ferry on dry salt flats as Birdie rides in.
Birdie shares her canteen and they sit in silence at the dry lake.
Birdie produces a telegram from his supposed sister saying come home.
Deacon puts down his rifle and reads the telegram beside Birdie.

s02061.summary: Captain Zara tracks the failing air scrubbers while Barnaby repairs and Solomon sorts seeds.
Barnaby promises a bypass in four minutes; Zara demands three and orders the seeds saved.
The sirens fall silent and the three listen to the failing air.
A masked woman enters with canisters and unmasks, revealing Zara's own face twenty years younger.

s01251.summary: Abigail rolls pastry in the kitchen while her sister rustles upstairs.
Rosalie comes down having lost her hat and they make tea in the rain.
Rosalie recalls their mother's words and tells Abigail she was good at being left.
The sisters peel apples in silence and Rosalie promises to write.

s01674.summary: A heist crew prepares in a cold warehouse, confident about the guard rotation.
Osei and Liv explain the camera loop and badge access, and the crew relaxes.
Lights blaze and security director Dominik thanks Liv for the invitation as guards surround them.
Beatrix lunges at Liv, Yusuf bolts and is tackled, and Liv says she did what she had to.

s00315.summary: Vic, Anna, and Reg surround a bound Deacon in the garage over a leaked list.
Vic accuses Deacon of selling the list; Deacon denies it.
Deacon points at Anna, the ring tightens, and footsteps echo down the ramp.

s00513.summary: Inspector Honoria inspects a cheese cave with its staff after a death.
Honoria questions about where the body lay and presses Rollo about stale mold.
Lowered lantern light reveals a trail of white powder leading down the tunnel.

s01502.summary: Four debtors share a freezing cell and gossip about the mad King.
Magnus wraps the shivering boy in his blanket and Jemima gives him a stocking.
Magnus says the Almighty writes him weather reports, and Ezekiel jokes to ask about the bailiff.

s02183.summary: The NICU team reviews patients at 3 a.m., worrying about bed eleven.
The chaplain asks about the parents; Faure says four, if nothing changes.
After a calm pause, an alarm begins sounding at bed eleven.

s00286.summary: A woman lies wedged under a collapsed garage slab, breathing carefully.
A rescuer's voice on the car radio reaches her; she gives her name and injuries.
Beatrix almost laughs and rests her head, watching the trembling headlamp beam.

s00420.summary: Haskell works on the foghorn when Delphine arrives with a covered birdcage.
Coast Guard radio says the lamp is out; Haskell reports all quiet.
The cage is empty, and something starts descending the dark tower stairs.

s02173.summary: Soldiers and a priest pass a quiet autumn morning in the monastery courtyard.
Marsh scolds Zeke for pacing while Deluca asks for garlic for his potatoes.
Marsh has Pike count eleven wounded, four unable to walk, and find transport.
A bell tolls, then proves to be the village bread bell and everyone relaxes toward the kitchen.

s01693.summary: Weary Opal folds scarves in lost property while an older man waits.
Opal asks about his lost gray coat and finds it with matching initials.
He gives his name, Ambrose Reinhardt, and the two recognize each other as father and daughter.
Ambrose clutches the coat to his chest as the shop bell rings for others.

s01528.summary: Junior arrives home to find his mother Polly frozen at the sink during a storm.
Junior answers the coast guard radio and relays that his father's boat sank with survivors, not him yet.
Polly hurls the stew bowl, then slumps while Junior kneels and takes her hands.
Polly asks him to light the lamp and he goes up into the dark.
